items.title: 新NISAを「国の優しさ」だと思っていると、AIサブスクで年50万円溶かして10年で500万円の機会損失が確定する
items.summary:
新NISAを「国の優しさ」だと思っていると、AIサブスクで年50万円溶かして10年で500万円の機会損失が確定する

「新NISAの非課税枠1800万円は国の優しさ」
そう信じているなら、今すぐ考えを改めるべきです。

多くの人が騙されていますが、新NISAの本当の狙いは「あなたの金融リテラシー格差」を浮き彫りにし、知っている者だけが得をする構造を固定化することです。

表面上のメリットばかり見て、月数万円のAIサブスク課金を見直さない人は、年間50万円、10年で500万円という、NISA非課税枠の約3分の1をドブに捨てているのと同じです。これは、あなたがAIで稼ごうとしている以上に、AIベンダーを肥え太らせている現実です。

（※AIで稼ぎたい人、資産形成を真剣に考えている人は絶対にブックマーク推奨です）

👇

■罠その1：AIサブスクの「月額20ドル」が麻痺させる金銭感覚

ChatGPT Plus $20、Claude Pro $20、Cursor $20、Midjourney $10〜$120、Notion AI $10〜$20、Perplexity $20、ElevenLabs $6〜$22、Suno $10、v0 by Vercel $20…

これらを複数契約すると、月額4〜5万円はあっという間です。年間50〜60万円。5年で250〜300万円がAIツールに消えています。
これは、新NISAの年間投資枠360万円の約15%に相当する金額です。
このお金があれば、10年後には複利でさらに大きな差が生まれます。

「たかが月20ドル」という感覚が、あなたの将来の資産を確実に奪っています。

■罠その2：新NISAの裏に隠された「情報格差」の拡大

新NISAの非課税枠1800万円は、誰もが平等に使えるわけではありません。
投資の知識、銘柄選定のノウハウ、市場の動向を読む力。これら「金融リテラシー」という名の情報が、投資の成否を決定的に分けます。

これは、私が個人で開発・運用している補助金検索サービスで痛感している現実と全く同じです。
補助金の公募要領は毎年更新され、数百ページに及ぶこともあります。採択されるか否かは、この膨大な情報の中から「自社に合った補助金を見つけ出し、採択されるためのツボを押さえる」という、まさに情報収集と分析の能力で決まります。

私はこの事業の運用者として、公募要領を読み解く時間も能力もない企業が、どれだけ機会損失しているかを目の当たりにしています。彼らは、本来受け取れるはずの数百万円、数千万円の資金を、ただ「知らない」というだけで逃しています。

新NISAも同じです。制度のメリットだけを喧伝し、その裏に潜む「知識の壁」を乗り越えられない人を、市場の養分にする構造が隠されています。

■罠その3：「API課金」と「ローカルLLM」を知らない情弱が搾取される構造

AIツールベンダーは、サブスクリプションで安定的な収益を得たいのが本音です。だから、APIの存在や、より安価な運用方法を積極的に伝えません。

ChatGPT Plusが月額20ドル（約3,000円）なのに対し、APIで同じGPT-4級のモデルを使えば、月数百円で済む場合がほとんどです。
さらに、PCのスペックによってはローカルLLMを動かすことも可能です。初期投資は数十万円から数百万円かかりますが、月々の利用料は電気代と微々たるものです。

この「APIやローカルLLMへの移行」という選択肢を知らない人は、永遠にベンダーのサブスク戦略に囚われ、無駄なコストを払い続けることになります。
彼らは「AIで稼ぐ」と言いながら、AIベンダーに稼ぎの大部分を吸い取られていることに気づいていません。

■罠その4：AIツールの「次世代版」「Pro版」への無限アップセルループ

「自分のレベルが上がったから上位プランへ」「Pro版じゃないと一流じゃない」
こうした煽り文句で、あなたは常に高額なプランへと誘導されます。

しかし、実際には無料版やAPI、そして「賢いプロンプティング」を組み合わせれば、ほとんどのニーズはカバーできます。
ベンダーは、顧客生涯価値（LTV）を最大化するため、あなたの「もっと良いものを使いたい」という心理を巧みに利用し、次々と新しい高額プランを提示してきます。

この無限ループにハマると、あなたのAIサブスク費用は青天井で増え続け、新NISAで得られるはずだった利益を確実に食い潰します。

■どうすればこの罠から抜け出せるのか？

解決策は「AIツール課金の見直しと、その余剰資金のNISAへの全額投資」一択です。

ステップ1：現在契約しているAIサブスクを全てリストアップし、用途別に分類する。
ステップ2：重複する機能のツールは、最も安価で必要十分なもの1つに絞る。
ステップ3：APIで代替可能なツールは、速やかにAPI利用に切り替える。
ステップ4：画像生成や一部のLLMは、ローカル環境での運用を検討する。
ステップ5：削減できた費用（月数万円）を、即座に新NISAの積立設定に回す。

これだけで、月4万円のAIサブスク費用が月5千円に削減できたとすれば、年間42万円、10年で420万円があなたの資産形成に直結します。
この420万円は、NISAの非課税枠の中で複利の恩恵を受け、さらに大きな金額へと成長します。

AIで稼ぐという夢は、無駄なコストを徹底的に削減し、その分を賢く投資に回して初めて現実のものとなります。
来月から、あなたのAIサブスクとNISAの見直しを始めてください。

---
AI副業仲間や、新NISAを始めた友人に、ぜひこの現実をシェアして教えてあげてください。
いいね、リポスト、ブックマークも忘れずに！

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. And Huang has presided over Nvidia’s effort to build out the AI ecosystem. In September, the company disclosed a staggering $99 billion worth of equity investments in this space, up from $2.2 billion two years ago. [...] President Donald Trump, left, and Open AI president Greg Brockman, right, listen as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at the White House in Washington, DC, on September 29, 2026, after meeting with top executives of AI firms.

When worries about cheaper open models from China sparked selling in global markets, Huang teamed up with Wall Street power players to cobble together a $500 billion plan aimed at keeping the flow of money pumping into AI-powering chips. [...] While Nvidia’s most recent annual financial report to regulators does not directly spell out how much the company’s fate is linked to Huang, the filing does note the company is “highly dependent” on the services of its executive team. It also acknowledges that “failure to ensure effective succession planning” could “hinder our strategic planning, execution and long-term success.”

Được xếp vào danh mục công nghệ chiến lược cấp quốc gia, công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen, đặc biệt là CRISPR/Cas, đang mở ra vận hội lớn để nông nghiệp Việt Nam chủ động thích ứng với biến đổi khí hậu và bảo đảm an ninh lương thực.

items.title: Cổ phiếu công nghệ Mỹ bị bán tháo, thổi bay mức kỷ lục 2.300 tỷ USD vốn hóa | Báo Dân trí
items.summary: Phải mất thêm một ngày sau cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ ở Mỹ, nỗi lo u về làn sóng đầu tư trí tuệ nhn tạo (AI) mới thực sự bùng lên với nhà đầu tư cổ phiếu. Nhưng khi điều đó xảy ra vào thứ năm, lực bán diễn ra không ngừng nghỉ. Nguyên nhn là nhiều cử tri bày tỏ sự phản đối các trung tm dữ liệu, và kỳ vọng ngày càng lớn về một sự thay đổi quy định có thể kìm hãm tăng trưởng của các nhà sản xuất chip và nhà cung cấp cho trung tm dữ liệu. [...] “Tôi không thấy khách hàng quay sang mua vào, cũng không thấy họ mua đuổi những cổ phiếu trước đy tăng kém”, bà Christina Jones tại JPMorgan viết trong một báo cáo. Theo bà, nơi duy nhất trên thị trường thực sự có dòng tiền dịch chuyển là trong nội bộ nhóm công nghệ, truyền thông và viễn thông. [...] Chỉ số Nasdaq 100 giảm 6,4%, thổi bay 2.300 tỷ USD giá trị vốn hóa, mức lớn nhất từng ghi nhận. Đy là mức giảm mạnh nhất kể từ tháng 4/2025, khi thị trường chao đảo vì đợt thuế quan đối ứng của Tổng thống Mỹ Donald Trump. Chỉ số đo lường cổ phiếu bán dẫn Mỹ lao dốc 12%, ghi nhận ngày tồi tệ nhất kể từ khi đại dịch Covid-19 bùng phát vào tháng 3/2020.

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
